name: AWS Rekognition
tagline: Amazon computer vision API for image and video analysis at scale
description: AWS Rekognition is Amazon's managed computer vision service for detecting objects, faces, text, unsafe content, and custom labels in images and videos. Developers call region-specific HTTPS endpoints with SigV4-signed requests to run analysis jobs, face comparison, and content moderation without training models. It integrates with S3, IAM, and other AWS services for production media pipelines.

auth.details: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) with IAM access key ID and secret access key (or temporary STS credentials). No simple API key header; requests must be signed per AWS protocol.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 12-mo Free Tier: 1,000 images/mo each Group 1 & Group 2 Image APIs (not Image Properties); 1,000 face + 1,000 user vector objects/mo; Video 60 min/mo. Custom Labels: 2 training + 1 inference hr/mo. Face Liveness: no free tier listed. Post-2025-07-15 new accounts: up to $200 AWS Free Tier credits may apply.

rate_limits: AWS publishes default service quotas (TPS) per API/region in Rekognition quotas docs and Service Quotas console; e.g. many image APIs default ~5 TPS (varies by API/region); limits are soft and increase-requestable
use_cases: detect objects and scenes in an image
moderate user-uploaded photos for unsafe content
compare two face images for identity match
extract text (OCR) from images and screenshots
index faces for search in a collection
